page: Google Cloud Platform e2-highmem-8 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the E2 cost-efficient family. It features 8 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7B12 processor using the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPU accelerators.

Performance benchmarks indicate a strong single-core CPU capability, with stress-ng single-core performance ranking in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench scores, and memory bandwidth tests generally fall within the average range. However, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and PassMark extended instructions tests show weaker relative performance, highlighting a potential tradeoff for highly parallelized or instruction-heavy compute tasks.

This instance offers qualitative cost efficiency by providing a substantial memory capacity on a budget-friendly platform. It is well-suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not require extreme compute performance, such as database operations, caching layers, in-memory data processing, and moderate web serving.
